# Screenshots

This directory holds the PNGs referenced from the top-level `README.md`.
**They are not generated by the build** — the UI author takes them
manually from a running instance and commits them alongside.

Expected filenames (referenced by the README):

| File                  | Contents                                           |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `dashboard.png`       | `/` route — dashboard with active jobs + recent runs |
| `project-overview.png`| `/projects/<slug>` Overview tab — RobotViewer + metadata |
| `runs-tab.png`        | `/projects/<slug>` Runs tab — live log + timeline + metric chart |
| `kg-tab.png`          | `/projects/<slug>` Knowledge Graph tab — paper browser + graph modal |
| `reports-tab.png`     | `/projects/<slug>` Reports tab — final report + timelapse |

A zero-byte placeholder file exists for `dashboard.png` so the README
image reference resolves when the project is cloned. Replace it with a
real capture before shipping.
